# Weekly Planner

> Home Assistant integration (HACS) that schedules service calls or scenes on any entity in weekly programs with modes, plus a bundled Lovelace card. Configurable by a YAML file (/config/www/weekly_planner.yml) or by the card.

Start with the AI guide: it explains how to discover what is configured, how to edit the YAML file and how to verify.

## Docs
- [AI guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/movrack/ha_weekly_planner/main/custom_components/weekly_planner/AI_GUIDE.md): discover, configure, verify, cautions
- [YAML example](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/movrack/ha_weekly_planner/main/custom_components/weekly_planner/example.yml): annotated, validated by tests
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/movrack/ha_weekly_planner/main/README.md): installation, entities, actions, YAML file, limits
- [Services](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/movrack/ha_weekly_planner/main/custom_components/weekly_planner/services.yaml): apply_now, skip_next, reload
